# Third-party code, fonts and data

- Tesseract.js and Tesseract.js-core: Apache 2.0. OCR language packages eng/rus/kaz contain Tesseract traineddata ([upstream](https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best), Apache 2.0).
- PDF-LIB: MIT. The @pdf-lib/fontkit browser build is a fork of [Fontkit](https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit); the published package identifies its license as MIT.
- Inter, Manrope and Noto Sans: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Full notices are included next to this file.
- Model data sources and terms are described in VALIDATION.md. In particular, the Kazakh model uses AINA-KK (CC BY-NC 4.0) for this educational project.
